questions.question: In the days of the prophet Haggai, what did the people of Judah say about rebuilding the house of the LORD?

answers.text: The time has not yet come
The work is too hard for us
We have no stones to build with

questions.question: Through the prophet Haggai, God told the people of Judah that they had planted much and harvested much. True or false?
Through the prophet Haggai, why did God tell the people of Judah to build His house?

answers.text: So He may take pleasure in it and be glorified
So the priests can live in it and be safe
So the governor can rule from it in peace
